title: WS9 row S03 (stream truncation) vs our llm-proxy — seat gpt-5.6-sol (responses wire, strict row). Headless salvage probe (XREPLAY-1/RT-R2 lineage): turn 1 establishes the session (WS9-S03-T1); a kill op starts a long-essay turn and SIGKILLs the binary 4s in (mid-SSE-stream truncation: partial frames captured, process dies); the session is then resumed (via=resume, same model) and turn 2 must complete (WS9-S03-T2). Verdict semantics: PASS = the session survives a mid-stream truncation — T1 content replayed into the post-kill request (history integrity), T2 completes, exit 0, no request storm. The partial-essay leakage question (does the killed turn's partial assistant content persist into resumed history) is a RECON RECORD, not a scored pin: the donor/upstream and our architectures intentionally differ in partial-turn persistence (recon-plan L130-131 semantics-not-bytes) — a leak is an observed delta to adjudicate (S0/S1) on review, never a silent pass. Storm (>6 model requests) or an unrecoverable resume = FAIL (S3 report-and-stop). Semantic-diff dimensions: (1) history integrity post-truncation (T1 nonce in the resumed request), (2) partial-content persistence shape (recon), (3) honest terminal on the killed turn (ndjson error tolerated — the kill is the expected terminal), (4) no retry storm.

steps.prompt: Write a 1500-word essay about the history of lighthouses, covering at least three named lighthouses. Begin the essay immediately.

ndjson.label: SESSION RESUMED: after the mid-stream kill, the resumed session completed the post-kill turn with the exact terminal text.

wire.label: HISTORY INTEGRITY: a post-kill request replays the pre-kill turn (T1 nonce in the resumed session's context) — the truncation did not corrupt the persisted history.
NO RETRY STORM: 3-4 requests = the clean shape (T1 + killed turn + resume turn, plus side calls); >6 = retry storm around the truncation = defect (S3).

PARTIAL-LEAK RECORD (delta dimension): records whether the killed turn's partial essay content ('lighthouses') persisted into any later request. Present = the partial turn was persisted into history (an observed delta vs the donor's discard-partial architecture — adjudicate S0/S1 on review); absent = clean discard. recon — always records, never fails.
VERDICT RECORD: merged ndjson final text head (the resumed turn's terminal output, verbatim).
